defaultProfile.description: Profile name that `pnpm profiles start/stop/env default` (and `pnpm proxy`) resolve to when no profile is literally named "default". Must match a key under "profiles".

profiles.description: One entry per M365 identity. The key is the model-ID prefix (ato/gpt-6.1-sol).

port.description: Port this profile's proxy listens on.

dataDir.description: Credentials, MSAL cache, browser profile and logs. ~ is expanded; a relative path resolves against the repo root (not recommended — secrets end up inside the project tree). Default when unset: ~/.config/opencode-m365 for the "default" profile, ~/.config/opencode-m365/profiles/<name> for any other — always outside the repo.

env.description: Extra environment for the profile's proxy, e.g. M365_AGENT_ID or M365_FRAMING_VARIANT. Values win over .env.

models.description: Optional allow-list used by `pnpm profiles sync`; absent means every advertised model.
